environment.description: Quarkus 2.16 native image deployed on AWS Lambda via quarkus-amazon-lambda-rest extension. PostgreSQL 14 RDS instance in same VPC. Database connection configured through RDS Proxy with IAM authentication using role 'inv_readonly_svc'. The PostgreSQL role 'inv_readonly_svc' was provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-role-manager' v3.2.1 which applies a restrictive default: the role inherits from pg_read_all_data (PostgreSQL 14+ built-in role) but has no membership in any role granting write access. Explicit REVOKE ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA inventory FROM inv_readonly_svc followed by GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA inventory TO inv_readonly_svc was applied in migration V47. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and pgaudit.log='write,ddl'. Note: the application code still constructs UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT statements and sends them to the database - they will receive permission denied errors at the database layer. Connection pool: Agroal max-size=5 with connection validation enabled.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with RDS Proxy
config.db_permissions: SELECT-only via explicit GRANT/REVOKE in migration V47, inherits pg_read_all_data
config.deployment: AWS Lambda with API Gateway (no request validation rules)
